description: This file defines a Drupal Views field plugin class 'Permissions' that provides a list of user permissions for display in views. It handles retrieving user roles, permissions, and rendering permission titles.

classes.name: Permissions
classes.description: A Drupal Views field plugin class that displays a list of permissions associated with user roles in a view.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes role storage and module handler dependencies.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the field, adding the 'uid' as an additional field for the query.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Prepares the query by adding additional fields and setting the field alias.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the permission data for each user based on their roles and permissions.

methods.name: render_item
methods.description: Renders a single permission item for display.
